newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grain markets lower in light trade.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grain markets lower in light trade.

text.p: UK physical grain prices fell sharply in line with the futures market, but trade was light.
"On paper it looks like there was been a lot of business but there is not much tonnage behind the numbers," said a trader.
Business was slow to get started following Wednesday's trade dinner in Bristol but delivered wheat was as much as 3.50 stg down by the middle of the afternoon.
"Sterling is strong again and people are not expecting any good news at the weekly (EU) grain tender," said another trader.
Lower French wheat prices also had an impact.
Feed wheat in East Anglia was trading as low as 99.50 stg for Jan/Mar while in the Liverpool area 102 stg was paid.

In the Avon range the lowest price reported so far is 100 stg for Jan/Mar. No barley business was seen while only one trade was reported for milling wheat 11 percent protein when Dec fetched 116 stg in the London area.
In the fob sector Jan/Mar feed wheat traded at 99.50 and Apr/Jun at 101 stg for 2,400 loads in coasters ex-east coast ports.
